en.headline: Planter fire at Tseung Kwan O PopCorn mall extinguished, no injuries
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in a planter on the platform of the PopCorn mall in Tseung Kwan O late Saturday night; no one was hurt and no evacuation was needed.
body: A planter on the platform of the PopCorn mall on Tong Yin Street in Tseung Kwan O caught fire at about 11:31 p.m. on Saturday, police and firefighters said.
Firefighters attended and extinguished the blaze. No one was injured and no evacuation was required.
Fire services are investigating the cause of the fire.

zh.headline: 將軍澳PopCorn商場平台花槽起火 消防撲熄無人傷
zh.dek: 周六晚上約11時31分，將軍澳唐賢街PopCorn商場平台花槽起火，消防將火救熄，無人受傷，毋須疏散。
body: 警方及消防表示，周六晚上約11時31分，將軍澳唐賢街9號PopCorn商場平台一個花槽起火。
消防接報到場將火撲熄。事件中無人受傷，毋須疏散。
